property_summary: For all callers and inputs, a non-owner calling sendMoney cannot make the contract transfer Ether out (address(c).balance does not decrease); removing the onlyOwner guard allows some non-owner call (with a callee that accepts and keeps Ether) to make the contract send funds and thus decrease address(c).balance.
change_summary: Remove the require guard so sendMoney (and other owner functions) become callable by anyone, changing observable behavior after sendMoney is called by non-owner accounts.
